metadata.title: Gallurio — Portfolio and Booking Tools for Creative Businesses
metadata.description: Create a polished portfolio page, showcase your work, and collect booking inquiries with Gallurio.

hero.headline: The booking-ready portfolio, run like a ledger.
hero.body: Photographers, videographers, and event creatives use Gallurio to publish a page worth trusting a booking to — and manage bookings, clients, and inquiries in one workspace.

whatIs.title: What is Gallurio?
whatIs.body: Gallurio is a portfolio and booking platform for creative professionals. It gives users tools to create a public-facing page, showcase their work, receive booking requests, and organize client-facing business details.

portfolioBuilder.title: Portfolio builder
portfolioBuilder.panelHeadline: Every gallery, service, and section — exactly as you'd lay it out yourself.
portfolioBuilder.description: Create a clean, professional portfolio page using flexible sections, gallery blocks, service details, and visual layouts made for creative work.

businessWorkspace.title: Business workspace
businessWorkspace.panelHeadline: One dashboard for everything between shoots.
businessWorkspace.description: Manage public profile content, business details, and booking-related setup from one dashboard.

bookingInquiryForms.title: Booking inquiry forms
bookingInquiryForms.panelHeadline: Requests land in your calendar, not your DMs.
bookingInquiryForms.description: Let visitors send booking requests directly through a user page, including event dates, contact details, service preferences, and project notes.

teams.title: Team collaboration
teams.panelHeadline: Invite the team, assign roles, and work off one shared calendar.
teams.description: Bring on staff and collaborators with role-based access to bookings, clients, and the calendar — so everyone knows what's theirs to handle without stepping on each other.

customBranding.title: Custom branding
customBranding.description: Adjust colors, typography, imagery, and page style so the portfolio feels aligned with the user's creative identity.

clientReadyPages.title: Client-ready pages
clientReadyPages.description: Publish a page designed to look credible, simple, and easy for potential clients to understand.

finalCta.title: Start building your creative workspace with Gallurio.
finalCta.subtitle: Start with one month of Pro free — no card required.

manifesto.quote: Every booking accounted for. Every client trusted. Nothing left ambiguous.

pricingTeaser.title: Simple pricing
pricingTeaser.subtitle: 1 month of Pro, free. Then one plan, monthly or yearly.
pricingTeaser.disclaimer: Prices are billed by Lemon Squeezy and shown in your local currency at checkout.

pro.name: Pro
pro.description: Unlimited bookings, clients, galleries, and your public page.

metadata.title: Terms of Service — Gallurio
metadata.description: Read the terms that govern access to and use of Gallurio.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro1: These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of Gallurio, including our website, application, portfolio tools, booking inquiry features, and related services.
terms.intro2: By using Gallurio, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, you should not use the service.

about.title: 1. About Gallurio
about.body1: Gallurio is a software platform that helps creative professionals and businesses create portfolio pages, present their services, and receive booking inquiries.
about.body2: Gallurio does not directly provide photography, videography, event planning, or other creative services to end clients. Users of Gallurio are responsible for the services they offer through their own pages.

eligibility.title: 2. Eligibility
eligibility.body: You may use Gallurio only if you are able to enter into a legally binding agreement. If you use Gallurio on behalf of a business, organization, or studio, you confirm that you are authorized to accept these Terms on its behalf.

accounts.title: 3. Accounts
accounts.body1: You may need to create an account to use certain Gallurio features. You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for all activity under your account.
accounts.body2: You agree to provide accurate information and to update it when necessary.

betaAccess.title: 4. Beta Access
betaAccess.body1: Gallurio may offer beta access before public launch. During beta, features may be incomplete, changed, limited, suspended, or removed at any time.
betaAccess.body2: Beta access does not guarantee continued free access, future feature availability, or permanent account availability.

userContent.title: 5. User Content
userContent.body1: Users may upload, publish, or submit content such as images, text, business information, service descriptions, portfolio materials, and booking form content.
userContent.body2: Users retain ownership of their content. By using Gallurio, users grant Gallurio permission to host, store, display, process, and transmit their content as needed to operate and improve the service.
userContent.body3: Users are responsible for ensuring that they have the rights, licenses, and permissions needed for any content uploaded or published.

prohibited.title: 6. Prohibited Content and Use
prohibited.intro: Users agree not to use Gallurio to upload, publish, distribute, or promote content that is unlawful, harmful, abusive, misleading, infringing, or otherwise inappropriate.
prohibited.item2: Infringing the intellectual property rights of others
prohibited.item3: Uploading malicious code or attempting to disrupt the service
prohibited.item5: Using the service for fraud, spam, or deceptive activity
prohibited.item6: Attempting to access accounts, systems, or data without permission
prohibited.outro: Gallurio may remove content or suspend accounts that violate these Terms.

bookings.title: 7. Bookings and Client Inquiries
bookings.body1: Gallurio may allow visitors to submit booking inquiries through user-created pages. These inquiries do not guarantee a confirmed booking unless separately agreed between the Gallurio user and their client.
bookings.body2: Gallurio is not responsible for disputes, payments, cancellations, service quality, schedules, or agreements between Gallurio users and their clients unless explicitly stated otherwise.

subscriptions.title: 8. Subscriptions and Payments
subscriptions.body1: Gallurio includes a paid Pro subscription, billed monthly or yearly. New workspaces receive one month of full Pro access at no charge, with no card required.
subscriptions.body2: After the free month, continuing to use Gallurio requires an active Pro subscription. Billing is processed by Lemon Squeezy, our Merchant of Record. Lemon Squeezy may handle payment processing, taxes, invoices, billing support, and applicable refund workflows.
subscriptions.body3: Users will be shown applicable pricing and billing terms before completing a purchase.
subscriptions.body4: If a subscription is not renewed or a payment fails, access to the workspace is limited until the subscription is restored. Account data is retained; a published public page may be taken offline after an extended period without payment, and everything is restored upon resubscribing.

cancellations.title: 9. Cancellations
cancellations.body1: Users may cancel subscriptions according to the cancellation process available in their account or through the billing flow provided.
cancellations.body2: Cancellation generally prevents future renewal charges, but it may not automatically result in a refund unless required by law or approved under the applicable refund process.

serviceChanges.title: 10. Service Changes
serviceChanges.body1: Gallurio may update, modify, suspend, or discontinue parts of the service at any time. Gallurio may also change features, plans, pricing, or usage limits as the product evolves.
serviceChanges.body2: Where appropriate, Gallurio will make reasonable efforts to notify users of material changes.

ip.title: 11. Intellectual Property
ip.body1: Gallurio, including its software, design, branding, interface, features, and related materials, is owned by Gallurio or its licensors.
ip.body2: Users may not copy, modify, reverse engineer, resell, or exploit any part of Gallurio except as permitted by these Terms or applicable law.

disclaimer.title: 12. Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: Gallurio is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis. Gallurio does not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted, error-free, secure, or suitable for every business need.

liability.title: 13. Limitation of Liability
liability.body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Gallurio will not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including lost profits, lost data, business interruption, or reputational harm.

termination.title: 14. Termination
termination.body1: Gallurio may suspend or terminate access if a user violates these Terms, misuses the service, creates risk for other users, or uses the service in a way that may harm Gallurio or third parties.
termination.body2: Users may stop using Gallurio at any time.

contact.title: 15. Contact
contact.body: For questions about these Terms, contact us at:

metadata.title: Privacy Policy — Gallurio
metadata.description: Learn how Gallurio collects, uses, stores, and protects information.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Gallurio collects, uses, stores, and protects information when users access the website, application, and related services.

account.title: Account Information
account.body: This may include name, email address, login details, business name, workspace information, and account preferences.

business.title: Business and Portfolio Information
business.body: This may include public profile details, service descriptions, images, galleries, branding settings, portfolio content, and other materials users choose to upload or publish.

bookingInquiry.title: Booking Inquiry Information
bookingInquiry.body: When visitors submit inquiries through a Gallurio page, Gallurio may collect information such as names, email addresses, event dates, project details, messages, and other form responses.

usage.title: Usage Information
usage.body: Gallurio may collect technical and usage data such as device information, browser type, IP address, pages viewed, actions taken, timestamps, and diagnostic logs.

payment.title: Payment Information
payment.body: Payments for the Gallurio Pro subscription are processed by Lemon Squeezy, Gallurio's Merchant of Record. Gallurio does not directly store full payment card details. Lemon Squeezy may collect and process billing details, payment information, tax information, and invoices according to its own terms and privacy practices.

useOfInfo.title: 2. How We Use Information
useOfInfo.item5: Improve product features and user experience
useOfInfo.item6: Provide support and respond to requests
useOfInfo.item9: Comply with legal and billing obligations

userContentPublic.title: 3. User Content and Public Pages
userContentPublic.body1: Content published on a Gallurio portfolio page may be visible to the public. This may include business names, images, services, descriptions, contact options, and other information users choose to make public.
userContentPublic.body2: Users are responsible for ensuring that published content does not include private or sensitive information that they do not want publicly available.

sharing.title: 4. Sharing of Information
sharing.body1: Gallurio may share information with trusted service providers that help operate the platform, such as hosting providers, authentication providers, analytics tools, email services, file storage providers, and payment processors.
sharing.body2: Gallurio may also share information when required by law, to protect rights, to prevent fraud or abuse, or as part of a business transfer such as a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets.
sharing.body3: Gallurio does not sell personal information.

security.title: 5. Data Storage and Security
security.body1: Gallurio uses reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect information. However, no system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
security.body2: Users are responsible for keeping account credentials safe and notifying Gallurio if they believe their account has been compromised.

retention.title: 6. Data Retention
retention.body1: Gallurio retains information for as long as needed to provide the service, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, enforce agreements, and maintain legitimate business records.
retention.body2: Users may request account deletion or data removal by contacting Gallurio, subject to legal, technical, or operational limitations.

cookies.title: 7. Cookies and Similar Technologies
cookies.body1: Gallurio may use cookies and similar technologies to keep users signed in, remember preferences, analyze usage, improve performance, and support security.
cookies.body2: Users can control cookies through browser settings, but disabling some cookies may affect how the service works.

international.title: 8. International Use
international.body1: Gallurio may be accessed from different countries. Information may be processed in countries where Gallurio or its service providers operate.
international.body2: By using Gallurio, users understand that information may be transferred and processed outside their country of residence, subject to applicable law.

children.title: 9. Children's Privacy
children.body1: Gallurio is not intended for children. Gallurio does not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age required by applicable law.
children.body2: If someone believes a child has provided personal information to Gallurio, they should contact Gallurio so the information can be reviewed and removed if appropriate.

changes.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
changes.body: Gallurio may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When material changes are made, Gallurio may notify users through the service, by email, or by updating the effective date.

contact.title: 11. Contact
contact.body: For privacy questions or requests, contact us at:

metadata.title: Refund Policy — Gallurio
metadata.description: Learn how Gallurio handles cancellations, refunds, and Lemon Squeezy payment processing.

betaPeriod.title: 1. Free Trial
betaPeriod.body1: New Gallurio workspaces receive one month of full Pro access at no charge, with no card required. No payment is collected during this trial, so no refund applies to it.
betaPeriod.body2: If you continue with a paid Pro subscription after the trial, the pricing and billing terms shown at checkout apply, and this Refund Policy governs any payment made.

subscriptions.title: 2. Subscriptions
subscriptions.body1: Gallurio Pro subscriptions are billed monthly, annually, or according to the billing period shown at checkout.
subscriptions.body2: Users may cancel their subscription to prevent future renewal charges. After cancellation, access may continue until the end of the current billing period unless otherwise stated.

refundRequests.title: 3. Refund Requests
refundRequests.intro: Refund requests are reviewed on a case-by-case basis.
refundRequests.item8: Lemon Squeezy's payment and refund process
refundRequests.outro: Submitting a refund request does not guarantee that a refund will be approved.

merchantOfRecord.title: 4. Lemon Squeezy as Merchant of Record
merchantOfRecord.body1: Payments for Gallurio may be processed by Lemon Squeezy, Gallurio's Merchant of Record. Lemon Squeezy may handle payment processing, taxes, invoices, billing support, and eligible refund processing.
merchantOfRecord.body2: If a user purchases a Gallurio subscription through Lemon Squeezy, their billing statement may show Lemon Squeezy or a related Lemon Squeezy billing descriptor.

nonRefundable.title: 5. Non-Refundable Situations
nonRefundable.intro: Unless required by law, refunds may not be provided for:
nonRefundable.item1: Unused time in a billing period after cancellation
nonRefundable.item4: Change of mind after substantial use
nonRefundable.item5: Issues caused by incorrect account setup or user-provided information
nonRefundable.outro: Gallurio will still review reasonable requests, especially where there are technical or billing issues.

howToRequest.title: 6. How to Request a Refund
howToRequest.body: To request a refund, contact us at:
howToRequest.outro: Gallurio may ask for additional information to verify the payment and review the request.

cancellations.title: 7. Cancellations
cancellations.body1: Users may cancel their subscription through account settings or the billing management flow provided.
cancellations.body2: Cancellation stops future renewals but does not automatically refund previous payments unless a refund is approved or required by law.

dragBlock.body: The panel lists every available block. Drag any block from here onto the canvas to add it to your page.

blockProps.title: Block properties live here
blockProps.body: Dropping a block selects it automatically — its settings appear in this panel.

contentTab.title: Content: the block's text and media
contentTab.body: The Content tab is where you edit the block's actual text, images, and links.

designTab.body: The Design tab controls typography, background color, borders, shadows, and animations.

layoutTab.title: Layout: size, spacing, and position

navDesign.title: Navigation · Design
navDesign.body: The Design tab controls header colors, borders, and typography for your nav links.

contactForm.title: Your inquiry form
contactForm.body: Click Contact Form to set up the form visitors use to reach you.

contactSetup.title: Contact · Setup
contactSetup.body: The Setup tab sets the form's language, title, and description. The form's fields and layout are fixed.

contactDesign.title: Contact · Design
contactDesign.body: The Design tab restyles the form — text and background colors to match your brand. You can't hide fields, only change how they look.

photos.title: Upload and organize photos
photos.body: Open Photos to create collections and upload images. Gallery blocks pull from a collection.

translate.title: Translate your public pages
translate.body: Switch the language of your navigation, contact form, and collection popups all at once. Right-to-left languages flip the layout automatically.

theme.title: Pick your colors and fonts
theme.body: Theme controls your five brand colors and typography. Every block's style options use this palette.

preview.title: Preview your site at any screen size
preview.body: Switch to preview mode and use the device toggle to check your layout on mobile, tablet, and desktop.

publish.title: Publish to go live
publish.body: When you're happy with your changes, click Publish to push them to your public page.

draftsStep.title: Save drafts and switch versions
draftsStep.body: Save changes at any time. Use Drafts to manage multiple versions. Reopen this tour via the Guide button.
